code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative neutropenia and lymphopenia with monocytosis. There is mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, INR, and alkaline phosphatase, suggesting inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and mild liver involvement. No evidence of acute myocardial injury or bacterial infection. Findings are consistent with acute or chronic inflammatory process, possible infection or hypoxic injury; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
